He founded Imperial Energy, building a Siberian oil business whose sale to ONGC Videsh generated a substantial personal fortune. His business interests have also included steel construction and substantial investment in ATOME, a developer of low-carbon fertiliser projects.

long_biography.plain_text:
The Levine Building at Trinity College, Oxford, reflects Peter Levine's lasting attachment to the college where he studied. His lead donation helped create teaching rooms, student accommodation and an auditorium, and the building honours his late parents, Gerry and Sadie. His support has also extended to fellowships and bursaries.

Levine entered Trinity in 1974 and later qualified as a solicitor. He has explained his giving as an expression of gratitude for the college's acceptance of him and his student experience. Opened in 2022, the building also improved access across the college, with adapted bedrooms, lifts and new access to the library.
